author: mypaperpleasure
html: Hi, Vira, I happened to come to your webpage through "Share a Pattern". I love your design and tutorials. Keep it up, looking forward to seeing more of your creations.

author: Vira
html: Thank you so much for your kind words! More patterns is coming! (including another christmas designs)

author: mypaperpleasure
html: Hi, Vira, It is me again, I come over through " Share A Pattern". Thank you for your kindness and thoughtfulness for creasing the mouse/rat for the Chinese New Year. It is lovely. I am a Chinese, so we will celebrate this coming Saturday, the first day of the Year Rat.

author: mypaperpleasure
html: I want to specially show my appreciation: thank you for keeping the patterns free. That is very generous. I find that some bloggers change their mind after being very popular.

author: Vira
html: I make both types of patterns - free and paid. Thank you for choosing my patterns! I will continue to create more free patterns!

author: Vira
html: I'm sorry that my answer so late... Thank you so much for your kind words and for choosing my patterns!
